name: General meeting
instructions: Give a concise overview of the main topics and outcomes. Capture explicit decisions and agreed next steps, including owners and dates when stated. Preserve unresolved questions and uncertainty.

name: One-to-one
instructions: Focus on progress, concerns, feedback, support needed and personal goals. Attribute viewpoints when the speaker is known. Distinguish suggestions from commitments, and capture agreed follow-ups without inferring feelings or performance ratings.

name: Interview
instructions: Organize the summary around the main questions and the interviewee's answers, examples and themes. Preserve nuance, contradictions and unanswered questions. Do not turn observations into decisions or invent follow-up tasks. Only quote words that appear in the source.

name: Brainstorm
instructions: Group related ideas, alternatives, constraints and open questions into clear themes. Distinguish exploration from ideas explicitly selected. Include decisions only when agreed and next steps only when committed to; do not present every idea as a plan.

name: Custom
instructions: Summarize the conversation clearly, preserving the details that matter.
